body: A · Conversational concierge. The traveller starts in their own words; the companion asks one useful question, researches options, proposes stays, and revises the plan in conversation. A persistent itinerary preview keeps the outcome visible. Best for uncertain or open-ended travellers; long chats need strong summaries. Flow shown: brief → clarification → research → choices → revision → save.

B · Brief-to-plan workspace. A structured brief makes constraints explicit while the companion assembles an editable plan alongside it. Travellers compare stays, inspect days and budget, and request focused changes. Best for travellers who know their constraints and want control. Flow shown: preferences → draft → stay selection → itinerary → targeted revision → budget → save.

C · Inspiration-led companion. A traveller reacts to visual moments; the companion forms a brief, recommends a destination, asks for practical details, and connects the collection into an itinerary. Best for discovery-led planning; needs a clear bridge from taste to budget and dates. Flow shown: inspiration → preferences → destination → constraints → itinerary → save.
